Sandbox_TheCoroner_XpMultiplier_tooltip:
Multiplies all First Aid XP given by the mod. Combined with the per-activity multipliers below (global x activity).
1 = default, 0 = no XP at all.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_AutopsyXpMultiplier_t:
XP from the autopsy minigame: incision, skin, ribs, chest plate and organs.
Multiplied by the global multiplier. 1 = default, 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_TimeOfDeathXpMultipli:
XP from a correct time of death estimate.
Multiplied by the global multiplier. 1 = default, 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_CauseOfDeathXpMultipl:
XP from a correct cause of death conclusion.
Multiplied by the global multiplier. 1 = default, 0 = no XP.
Sandbox_TheCoroner_TremorMultiplier_tool:
Multiplies how much the hands shake during the autopsy minigame (incision, ribs, organs).
1 = default, 0.5 = half as much, 0 = perfectly steady hands.
